image_description: A large, silver-grey airship (dirigible) hovering low over a body of water with a tree line in the background. The airship features a streamlined, elongated envelope with a blue and yellow stripe running horizontally. Text is visible on the side of the hull. A gondola structure is suspended beneath the forward-middle section. Cruciform tail fins are visible at the rear. The sky is overcast.
